data.title: DevOps-Engineer Bank

DevOps-Engineer Bank

Design, Entwicklung und Pflege zuverlässiger Softwarelösungen für die Prozesse des Treasury und Risk Managements / Entwicklung und Optimierung von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitHub Actions / Erstellung und Verwaltung von containerisierte Anwendungen auf Cloud-Plattformen wie OpenShift / Support der Risikomanagement-Systeme zur Sicherstellung einer hohen Verfügbarkeit und Leistung / Zusammenarbeit mit interdisziplinären Teams zum besseren Verständnis der Anforderungen und zur Entwicklung optimaler, technischer Lösungen / Monitoring der Systeme und Behebung von Systemproblemen zur Sicherstellung minimaler Ausfallzeiten und schneller Wiederherstellung / Laufende Bewertung und Implementierung von Best Practices / Dokumentation der Prozesse und Arbeitsabläufe / Sicherstellung des kontinuierlichen Wissensaustausches und die Aufrechterhaltung des Betriebs.

Ihr Profil:

Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Informatik oder Ingenieurwesen / Fundierte Kenntnisse einer Bank, der Finanzinstrumente und Risikomanagementprozesse / Projekterfahrung im Bereich DevOps-Engineering mit Schwerpunkt auf Cloud-Technologien und CI/CD-Pipelines in einer Bank / Erfahrung mit GitHub und im Aufbau und Management von CI/CD-Pipelines mit modernen DevOps-Tools / Verwendung von Open-Source-Distributionen / Ausgeprägte Kenntnisse im Bereich Scripting (Python) für Automatisierung und betriebliche Effizienz / Erfahrung mit Überwachungs-, Protokollierungs- und Dashboard-Tools / Projekterfahrung in Microsoft –Umgebungen (z. B. Azure) / Verständnis der besten Sicherheitspraktiken / Interesse, in einer dynamischen Umgebung effektiv zu arbeiten / Teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägten Problemlösungsfähigkeiten / Deutsch und Englisch.

data.title: Lead Platform Engineer
data.description:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Department Description

Platform Engineering is the centralised team that builds, provisions and runs the infrastructure every other engineering team at Allica depends on. Whether a product serves a business banking customer or a colleague inside the bank, it lands on a platform this team designed. The team owns both halves of that, building the platform and running it, against the availability and resilience standards a regulated bank is held to. Well-architected is the operating standard, not an aspiration: reliability, security, cost and operational excellence are design inputs from the start.

The job is to make the right thing the easy thing, through paved roads, self-service provisioning, sensible defaults, and controls encoded in the platform rather than bolted on afterwards. Every control the platform enforces is one a product team does not have to think about, and one we can evidence on demand. Role Description The Lead Platform Engineer is the senior technical leader for a core domain of Allica's platform. You set its technical direction, you are accountable for how it behaves in production, and you build it yourself.

data.title: DevSecOps Engineer (f/x/m)
data.description:
💸 spotixx is a Frankfurt-based European FinTech building technology for the regulated financial sector. Since 2019, we have grown into a team of 60+ professionals with deep roots in the German and European banking landscape, shaped by years of hands-on experience in fraud investigation and financial crime prevention. We specialize in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and fraud detection, enabling secure, compliant data exchange between financial institutions. Using advanced data science and AI, we are helping shift the industry toward collaborative intelligence and more effective prevention. As a self-funded company, we focus on sustainable growth and real impact. With offices in Frankfurt and Wilhelmshaven and strong inbound demand, we are expanding our team. If you want to work on meaningful problems, grow with the company, and be part of a flexible, hybrid work environment, spotixx offers the opportunity to do just that.

Tasks: what you will do

  • Own the infrastructure as code. Define and maintain every environment in code so they are reproducible and consistent.

  • Secure the delivery pipeline. Keep CI/CD trustworthy end to end - from keyless authentication to verified, attested deployments.

  • Run the cloud and network security controls. Manage edge protection, private networking, and segmentation across the platform.

  • Operate vulnerability management. Keep scanning and posture checks running, triaged, and turned into tracked, time-bound work.

data.title: Software Engineer, Payments
data.description:
Lemonway is an authorised payment institution at the heart of Europe’s new digital economy.

We secure payments for crowdfunding platforms, the collaborative economy, marketplaces, and e-commerce businesses, with a strong commitment to fraud prevention and the protection of customer funds.

Regulated by the French Prudential Supervision and Resolution Authority (ACPR) and benefiting from the European passport in 29 countries, Lemonway is based in Paris and brings together 150 multicultural and committed Lemonheroes.

More than 400 marketplaces trust us with their payments. We manage 1.4 million user wallets and have raised €50 million from Breega, Speedinvest, and Toscafund.

Profitable for the past four years and growing by 25% in 2025, Lemonway aims to remain one of Europe’s leading payment providers through healthy and sustainable growth.

  • Industry: FinTech and online payments

  • Location: Paris, France, in the Sentier district, 2nd arrondissement

  • Remote work: Up to two days per week, with flexibility


Your mission

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join the Payments Tribe, a critical part of our platform powering the payment experience across channels. You will report to the Engineering Manager of the Tribe and work closely with eight engineers across two squads: Core Banking and Payments.


You will drive the enhancement of our platform by specifying, implementing, testing, monitoring, and troubleshooting the services provided to our customers. You will work across payment APIs, payment processing, reconciliation, and core banking systems.

data.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (m/f/d)
data.description:
YOUR JOB

AI can write code now. It can't decide what's worth building, and it can't tell whether its own output is right. That part is yours. As a Fullstack Software Engineer in our customer-facing feature team, you'll take on real problems, often co-leading an initiative with a fellow engineer. You'll carry them from the first discovery conversation to production and beyond, working with Product, Design and engineers who would rather own an outcome than close a ticket. What you build lands with many companies working to keep their data, and the people behind it, safe.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Own what you build, end to end. Shape capabilities in discovery with your Product Owner and Designer, build them across frontend and backend, ship them to production, and make sure they work properly in customers' hands.

data.title: Product Frontend Engineer
data.description:
quinn is becoming the way people employ, across the globe, through one app.

quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer: quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end.

Where everyone else sells software, quinn sells the outcome. We don't sell payroll software. We run payroll.

The purpose behind it is simple: Fair employment. For all. Correct and fair employment, made simple and accessible for any employer and any employee, in any market quinn enters.

Where this is going

Think about what Revolut did to banking. All of the complexity (the regulation, the clearing, the compliance) handled invisibly in the background, and one simple experience at the front. Nobody using Revolut thinks about what happens behind the screen when they open a new account, swap currencies or send money abroad. It just works, in a couple of taps. Nobody should have to think about it in order to employ someone either.

That is what quinn is building, and it is further along than most people assume: a profitable core business, running today in Switzerland, Germany and the UK, expanding into new markets both by launching and by acquiring. By 2030 quinn intends to be the destination brand for fair employment across six countries and more, on one platform, with one experience.
